images.prompt: A simple diagram showing a company building with its name prominently displayed. Several smaller, identical puzzle pieces are shown being detached from the building, each labeled "Share" or "Stock". People are depicted holding these puzzle pieces, smiling, illustrating their ownership stake in the company. The overall style is clean and illustrative, emphasizing the concept of fractional ownership.

images.prompt: A comparison table infographic titled "Common vs. Preferred Stock". The table has two columns, "Common Stock" and "Preferred Stock", and rows for key features: "Voting Rights" (Yes/No), "Dividend Priority" (Last/First), "Dividend Type" (Variable/Fixed), "Claim on Assets in Liquidation" (Last/Higher), and "Growth Potential" (High/Limited). Each cell contains a concise description or icon representing the feature.
